visual.general_description: Three brain MRI views (coronal, sagittal and axial) each with a red arrow pointing to a small round lesion in the posterior fossa.
visual.detailed_description: Three grayscale T1-weighted brain MRI images arranged side by side with a black background. The left image is a coronal slice, the middle image is a sagittal slice and the right image is an axial slice through the posterior fossa. Each image has a red arrow pointing at a small round lesion with a bright rim and a darker center in the cerebellum near its posterior surface. In the coronal and axial images the lesion lies on the side marked R, which is the left of the image, and in the sagittal image it lies in the posterior cerebellum near the occipital bone. Each image carries overlay text in the corners with the hospital name, a patient identifier, sex, age, scan date and time, series and image numbers, matrix size, slice position, window width and level, orientation letters (R, L, A, P, H, F), and sequence parameters; sequence names beginning T1W_3D_TFE are printed on the images.
